title: Validation Catalyst Sample 01
body: Problem: reviewers need structured summaries. Request: build a cited review helper. Impact: faster review triage. Feasibility: milestone and team data are included. Risk: source pages may change.

citations.title: Validation Catalyst Sample 01
citations.snippet: Request: build a cited review helper.

title: Validation Catalyst Sample 02
body: Problem: proposal evidence is scattered. Request: normalize snippets into citations. Impact: clearer reviewer notes. Feasibility: TypeScript prototype and docs. Risk: citation drift.

title: Validation Catalyst Sample 03
body: Problem: reviewers need comparison consistency. Request: fixed rubric command. Impact: less ad hoc review. Feasibility: deterministic rubric. Risk: rubric may miss domain nuance.

title: Validation Catalyst Sample 04
body: Problem: evidence quality varies. Request: source cache and missing-evidence flags. Impact: transparent caveats. Feasibility: fixture-backed tests. Risk: false confidence if citations are stale.

title: Validation Catalyst Sample 05
body: Problem: proposal bodies are long. Request: concise source-grounded sections. Impact: reviewer time savings. Feasibility: sample-first demo. Risk: live ingestion remains a blocker.

title: Validation GovTool Sample 06
body: Problem: DReps need rationale drafts. Request: template workflow. Impact: clearer public reasoning. Feasibility: small command surface. Risk: drafts must not choose a stance.

title: Validation GovTool Sample 07
body: Problem: governance actions need readable source lists. Request: sources command. Impact: auditability. Feasibility: citation rendering. Risk: missing sources must be explicit.

title: Validation GovTool Sample 08
body: Problem: governance summaries need caveats. Request: guardrail policy. Impact: safer review drafts. Feasibility: output guard tests. Risk: guard patterns need ongoing updates.

title: Validation GovTool Sample 09
body: Problem: governance provenance is weak. Request: proof payload hashing. Impact: audit trail metadata. Feasibility: SHA-256 utility. Risk: external tx verification is pending.

title: Validation GovTool Sample 10
body: Problem: users need a Telegram path. Request: command router. Impact: demoable workflow. Feasibility: deterministic script. Risk: production bot token is external.

title: Validation User Sample 11
body: Problem: pasted text may be the only source. Request: normalize text fallback. Impact: MVP still works offline. Feasibility: local parser. Risk: provenance depends on the user.

title: Validation User Sample 12
body: Problem: source snapshots need hashes. Request: hashing utility. Impact: reproducible receipts. Feasibility: crypto standard library. Risk: hash does not prove source truth.

title: Validation User Sample 13
body: Problem: docs need local setup steps. Request: README and architecture notes. Impact: easier reviewer testing. Feasibility: npm scripts. Risk: live integrations remain manual.

title: Validation User Sample 14
body: Problem: command output needs consistent sections. Request: proposal command contract. Impact: predictable review notes. Feasibility: command unit tests. Risk: heuristic extraction is basic.

title: Validation User Sample 15
body: Problem: comparisons can drift. Request: fixed rubric fields. Impact: consistent DRep review. Feasibility: deterministic scoring. Risk: score is a signal, not a decision.

title: Validation User Sample 16
body: Problem: missing citations must be visible. Request: unavailable-source status. Impact: no fabricated sources. Feasibility: guard test. Risk: users may need to paste better sources.

title: Validation User Sample 17
body: Problem: proof receipts should be payload-only. Request: metadata schema. Impact: auditability without custody. Feasibility: local hash. Risk: external verification needs an indexer.

title: Validation User Sample 18
body: Problem: CLI demos must be repeatable. Request: run-demo script. Impact: quick local evaluation. Feasibility: sample fixtures. Risk: not a live Telegram service.

title: Validation User Sample 19
body: Problem: MVP scope can creep. Request: non-goals in docs. Impact: safer funding story. Feasibility: explicit safety policy. Risk: later phases need governance decisions.

title: Validation User Sample 20
body: Problem: production blockers need reporting. Request: implementation report. Impact: clear handoff. Feasibility: command log. Risk: real token and live APIs are not included.
